PC: Obtain a complete history from the patient, including all medications the patient is taking.
The medical student should then inquire about where the patient obtains the needles and syringes and if he uses anyone else’s or shares his with other people.
SBP: The student should ask the patient whether he wants to have the testosterone be formally prescribed—either by the current health care team or making a referral to someone who does transgender care.

The student should discuss the electronic health record system which currently recognizes the non-preferred legal name and then discuss how to meet the patient’s needs to avoid mis-gendering and mis-naming.
ICS: The ideal behavior is the student asks the patient what name/pronoun he prefers.
